name: 左上品牌區＋底部連結列＋右下大按鈕
desc: 上方留大片空白的頁尾：左上是標誌與次要資訊文字，最下方一列左側是橫向文字連結、右側只有一顆大按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。頁尾上方留大片空白，約三分之一個畫面高。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約四分之三、右側約四分之一。左側上半部是品牌區，靠左放標誌，約佔內容寬度的四分之一，下方可放多行次要資訊文字與一個小型文字連結，沒有時省略；品牌區下方留一段空白，左側最下方是一排橫向排列的文字連結，沒有小標題。右側最下方放主要按鈕，明顯大於文字連結，底緣和左側那排文字連結對齊；右側只有這一個按鈕。頁尾內沒有分隔線，也沒有底部列。
mobile: 左右兩區改為單欄，所有元素水平置中，由上往下依序是：文字連結改為直向堆疊並全部展開、標誌、次要資訊文字與小型文字連結、主要按鈕；文字連結從桌機的最下方移到最上方。主要按鈕約佔畫面寬的七成。頁尾上方的大片空白縮小為一般留白。

en.name: Top-left brand block + bottom link row + large bottom-right button
en.desc: A footer with a large empty space at the top: the logo and secondary text sit at the top left, and the last row holds horizontal text links on the left and a single large button on the right.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. Leave a large empty space at the top of the footer, about one-third of a viewport high. It is split into two zones aligned to the page content width: the left about three-quarters and the right about one-quarter. The upper half of the left side is the brand block: a left-aligned logo about one-quarter of the content width, below which there may be several lines of secondary text and one small text link; omit them when there is no content. Leave a gap below the brand block; at the very bottom of the left side is a row of text links laid out horizontally, with no group headings. At the very bottom of the right side place a primary button, clearly larger than the text links, its bottom edge aligned with the row of text links on the left; this single button is the only element on the right side. There are no dividers and no bottom bar inside the footer.
en.mobile: The two zones become a single column with every element horizontally centered, in this order from top to bottom: the text links, now stacked vertically and fully expanded; the logo; the secondary text and small text link; the primary button. The text links move from the bottom on desktop to the top. The primary button spans about seven-tenths of the screen width. The large empty space at the top of the footer shrinks to normal spacing.
